purpose: Three preview-only style prototypes for copper in L1 earth; not yet a seamless production tileset.

variants.name: 1-natural
variants.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE square, fully opaque hand-painted 2D game terrain tile prototype, copper ore embedded in L1 brown surface EARTH. Generate a NEW tile, not an edit of the reference screenshot. Input image role: visual reference only for camera, earthy palette, warm COPPER, and shallow embedded broken edges; not for copying its scene or composition. Orthographic straight-on view of the game terrain plane. Fill the whole square with compacted warm brown earth, coarse grains and small pebbles. A single compact irregular COPPER occurrence in the middle occupies about 55 percent of tile width, with a few smaller connected copper inclusions. Surrounding earth overlaps a little at irregular broken margins, with short shallow side faces, a modest shadow just below the upper earth lip, thin lower edge. Ground and ore must be one unified painted tile, visibly embedded, no stuck-on cluster. Keep about 15 percent earth-only margin around all outer edges. Copper is orange-brown metallic mineral, NOT orange gemstone, NOT garnet, NOT lava. Subtle natural warm metallic highlights, no emission, no sparkles, no stars. Lighting from upper left. Absolutely no text, no number, no border, no sprite sheet, no comparison panels, no UI, no miner, no objects outside the tile, no isometric floating cube, no deep canyon, no tall cliff wall. Square 1024x1024 composition. Style variant 1: naturalistic mineral illustration, moderately detailed hand-painted game art. Irregular native copper seams, flattened rough metallic plates and knobby inclusions partially embedded in gritty brown soil. Restrained orange/umber/copper palette, believable uneven oxidation shading and muted earthy dark crevices. Varied sizes, asymmetric cluster with a broad exposed nugget plus short branching veins. Detailed but readable at small game scale. Not photographic or glossy 3D.
